text: Baseline resolution is ordered as `HEAD~1`, then `git merge-base ORIG_HEAD HEAD` when `HEAD~1` is unavailable and `ORIG_HEAD` exists, then a synthetic empty-tree baseline. Before mapping, sync ignores `.outcomegraph/work/**`, `.outcomegraph/cache/**`, `.outcomegraph/events/**`, and `.outcomegraph/objects/**`; if filtering removes all diff paths, the pass is treated as unchanged unless a full-sync flag is requested.
